summary: The pre-market setup is a tape that looks calm on the surface and stretched underneath. The composite risk score is 43.17, essentially flat on the day at -0.01 but up 2.12 over the week, and the regime is still goldilocks at a caution reading. The overnight move happened in rates rather than in risk appetite: the nominal ten-year rose to 4.69 from 4.63, the two-year to 4.25 from 4.18 and the real ten-year to 2.43 from 2.41, which leaves the macro block at 65.33 as the only stretched dimension while volatility sits at 25.15 and liquidity and credit at 33.61. The Asian session closed with the domestic memory chain under pressure even though memory dominated the overnight headline flow, and the largest single contribution to the score is a proxy: cross-asset confirmation at 0.375, worth 7.50. Into the US open the question is whether disinflation can pull the long end back down before the consumer price report lands midweek.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro block is the only stretched dimension at 65.33, with the real ten-year rate at 2.43 sitting in the 99.04 percentile and the nominal ten-year at 4.69 in the 97.99 percentile.
Rates backed up across the curve overnight, with the two-year at 4.25 against 4.18 prior and the ten-year at 4.69 against 4.63, compressing the ten-year over the two-year spread to 0.44.

The single largest contribution to the score comes from cross-asset confirmation at 0.375, worth 7.50, and it is a proxy rather than a measured input, so the top of the driver list rests on the weakest evidence in the stack.

Payrolls turned outright negative at -23.0 from a prior 20.0 while the unemployment rate fell to 4.1 from 4.2, but participation slipped to 61.4 from 61.5 and continuing claims rose to 1801000 from 1777000, so the better rate is composition rather than strength.

supporting_signals.claim: Reverse repo balances at 1.45 sit in the 7.39 percentile and contribute 3.41, the third largest single contribution, showing how thin the buffer at the front end has become.
Only 0.1039 of the universe is making new highs while 0.6818 holds above its long moving average, and the new highs ratio alone contributes 2.42 — participation is broad but shallow.
Memory is the weakest theme on the day at -0.2868 even though it dominated the overnight headline flow, where the top ranked story carries an importance of 61.57.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility scores 25.15 with the index at 15.15 against 15.81 prior, and liquidity and credit score 33.61 with high yield spreads tightening to 2.71 from 2.75 while investment grade holds at 0.78.

Headline inflation eased to 3.46353 from 4.16661, core to 2.56579 from 2.82294 and core PCE to 3.28653 from 3.42158, while the five-year forward at 2.28 and the ten-year breakeven at 2.25 stay anchored.

Theme breadth is decisively risk-on, with AI software up 6.0538, quantum computing up 5.7226, cloud computing up 3.7054 and semiconductor equipment up 3.5532, and the trend block still shows a drawdown of 0.0 from the fifty-two week high.

what_changed_today: Rates rose across the curve overnight while the volatility index fell, an unusual pairing that left the composite score flat at -0.01 on the day.
The Chinese session closed with the domestic memory and packaging chain broadly lower: GigaDevice -3.3617, Ingenic -3.8667 and Montage -3.9904, with Longsys the exception at +6.6994.
Continuing claims are up at 1801000 while participation slipped to 61.4, keeping the labour mix soft even as the unemployment rate improved to 4.1.
Cross-asset confirmation reads 0.375, leaving the biggest driver of the score resting on a proxy input.
watch_next: The consumer price report is the first hard test and lands midweek, on the same day as the Cisco print.
Producer prices follow the next day and advance retail sales the day after, so the back half of the week carries the entire macro calendar.
Watch whether the memory complex re-couples with the rest of semis: memory at -0.2868 against semiconductors at 2.0187 and semiconductor equipment at 3.5532 is a wide gap to sustain.
If the ten-year holds above its current 4.69 into the inflation print, the macro block stays the binding constraint on the score.

bull_case.title: Bull case: disinflation pulls the long end down
points: Headline inflation at 3.46353 and core at 2.56579 are both well below their prior prints, and core PCE has eased to 3.28653.
Expectations stay anchored with the five-year forward at 2.28 and the ten-year breakeven at 2.25, so the nominal leg can fall without a growth scare.
Credit already agrees, with high yield at 2.71 in the 10.29 percentile and investment grade at 0.78 in the 17.43 percentile.

base_case.title: Base case: calm tape, stretched macro, no resolution before the data
points: The score holds near 43.17 in the caution band and the regime stays goldilocks, because a macro block at 65.33 is offset by volatility at 25.15 and credit at 33.61.
Breadth stays broad but shallow, with 0.6818 above the long average and only 0.1039 at new highs against 0.013 at new lows.
Crypto offers no independent signal, with bitcoin at 65001.0, ether at 1918.64 and solana at 76.61 all effectively unchanged.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the real rate breaks the goldilocks frame
points: The real ten-year at 2.43 is in the 99.04 percentile and the nominal at 4.69 in the 97.99 percentile; at those levels the discount rate does the damage regardless of the growth path.
Payrolls at -23.0 against a prior 20.0 say the growth leg is already cracking, and the unemployment rate at 4.1 flatters it only because participation fell to 61.4.
With cross-asset confirmation at 0.375 there is no corroboration from other asset classes, so a rates-driven repricing would find equity positioning offside.
